vocabulary.meaning_en: to make something clear and easy to understand
vocabulary.example: Could you please clarify what you mean?

vocabulary.meaning_en: something that shows what you mean

vocabulary.note_ar: يمكن أن تُنطق t خفيفة كالهمزة: comple'ly
vocabulary.note_en: The t can be soft, almost silent.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the last time to finish something
vocabulary.example: Can we set a deadline for this task?
This is a high priority task.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to plan for a certain time
comments about how well you did
vocabulary.example: Do you have any feedback for me?

vocabulary.meaning_en: when something happens later than planned

vocabulary.example: Can we discuss this after prayer?
Let's have a quick coffee break.

vocabulary.meaning_en: something more important than other things
vocabulary.example: This is a high priority task.

fine_lines.title: I'll vs I will
fine_lines.explanation_ar: I'll اختصار I will، وهي الأكثر استخدامًا في الكلام. I will أقوى قليلًا ومناسبة للكتابة الرسمية. انطق اللام في I'll ثقيلة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: "I'll" is short for "I will" and is more common in speech. "I will" is a little stronger and good in formal writing.

examples.sentence: I will send you the report by tomorrow.

fine_lines.title: Clarify what you mean vs What do you mean?
fine_lines.explanation_ar: في السؤال المباشر نقول What do you mean? لكن داخل جملة أخرى نقول what you mean بدون do: Could you clarify what you mean?
fine_lines.explanation_en: As a direct question: "What do you mean?" Inside another sentence, drop "do": "Could you clarify what you mean?"

examples.sentence: Could you please clarify what you mean?

fine_lines.title: by tomorrow vs until tomorrow
fine_lines.explanation_ar: by tomorrow = في موعد أقصاه الغد. until tomorrow = حتى الغد (يستمر الشيء إلى الغد).
fine_lines.explanation_en: "By tomorrow" = not later than tomorrow. "Until tomorrow" = continuing up to tomorrow.

examples.sentence: I'll send you the report by tomorrow.
The office is closed until tomorrow.

expressions.example: Good morning, everyone. Let's begin.

expressions.meaning_en: A polite way to start a meeting.
expressions.example: It's ten o'clock. Shall we get started?

expressions.phrase: Could you please clarify what you mean?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكنك توضيح ما تقصده من فضلك؟
expressions.example: Could you please clarify what you mean by 'soon'?

expressions.meaning_en: Asking for an example to understand better.
expressions.example: That idea sounds good. Can you give an example?
I completely agree with you. Let's do it.
I see your point, but we don't have the budget.
Don't worry about the booking. I'll take care of it.

expressions.phrase: Can we set a deadline for this task?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكننا تحديد موعد نهائي لهذه المهمة؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking for a clear finish date.
expressions.example: Can we set a deadline for this task? Maybe next Thursday?
We need more time to discuss this. Let's schedule a meeting.

expressions.phrase: I'll send you the report by tomorrow.
expressions.meaning_ar: سأرسل لك التقرير قبل نهاية الغد.
expressions.meaning_en: A promise to send something soon.
expressions.example: I'll send you the report by tomorrow morning.

expressions.meaning_en: Used in emails when you attach a file.
expressions.example: Dear Ahmed, please find the attached file.

expressions.meaning_en: Ending an email; you wait for an answer.
expressions.example: Thank you for your time. Looking forward to your reply.
The client hasn't answered yet. I'll keep you updated.

expressions.phrase: Do you have any feedback for me?
expressions.example: I finished the design. Do you have any feedback for me?

expressions.phrase: Is there anything I can help you with?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل هناك شيء يمكنني مساعدتك فيه؟
expressions.example: I'm free this afternoon. Is there anything I can help you with?
We finished on time. Thanks for your support.

expressions.meaning_en: A formal apology for being late.
expressions.example: I apologize for the delay in my reply.

expressions.phrase: I'll make sure this doesn't happen again.
expressions.example: I'm sorry. I'll make sure this doesn't happen again.

expressions.meaning_en: Let's finish the meeting or task.
expressions.example: We've covered everything. Let's wrap this up.
That's all for today. Thanks, everyone, for your time.

expressions.phrase: Can we discuss this after prayer?
expressions.meaning_ar: هل يمكننا مناقشة هذا بعد الصلاة؟
expressions.meaning_en: Asking to continue later, after prayer time.
expressions.example: It's prayer time now. Can we discuss this after prayer?

expressions.phrase: Let's have a quick coffee break.
expressions.example: We've been working for two hours. Let's have a quick coffee break.

expressions.phrase: This is a high priority task.
expressions.meaning_en: This task is very important and urgent.
expressions.example: Please start now. This is a high priority task.

expressions.phrase: I'll get back to you soon.
expressions.example: Let me check with my manager. I'll get back to you soon.
It's a big project. Let's work together on this.

grammar.title: I'll + verb (offers and promises)
grammar.explanation_ar: I'll = I will. نستخدمها لنعرض فعل شيء أو نعد به: I'll take care of it، I'll keep you updated، I'll get back to you.
grammar.explanation_en: "I'll" = I will. Use it to offer or promise: I'll take care of it, I'll keep you updated.
examples: I'll get back to you soon.

grammar.title: Let's + verb / Shall we + verb?
grammar.explanation_ar: Let's + فعل أصلي لاقتراح شيء معًا. Shall we + فعل أصلي؟ سؤال مهذب لاقتراح شيء: Shall we get started?
grammar.explanation_en: "Let's + base verb" suggests doing something together. "Shall we + base verb?" is a polite suggestion as a question.

grammar.title: Indirect questions: clarify what you mean
grammar.explanation_ar: عندما يأتي السؤال داخل جملة أخرى نحذف do ونرتب الكلمات مثل الجملة العادية: What do you mean? → Could you clarify what you mean?
grammar.explanation_en: When a question is inside another sentence, drop "do" and use normal word order: What do you mean? → Could you clarify what you mean?
examples: Could you please clarify what you mean?
Can you tell me where the room is?
I don't know what he wants.

grammar.title: Looking forward to + noun / verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: بعد looking forward to نضع اسمًا أو فعلًا ينتهي بـ ing، لأن to هنا حرف جر: looking forward to your reply / to meeting you.
grammar.explanation_en: After "looking forward to" use a noun or verb-ing, because "to" is a preposition here.
examples: I'm looking forward to meeting you.
We look forward to working with you.

questions.question: You want to start the meeting politely. You say:
questions.explanation_ar: Shall we get started? = هل نبدأ؟

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
choices: Could you clarify what do you mean?
Could you clarify what you mean?
Could you clarify what you means?
Could you clarify what does you mean?
questions.explanation_ar: في السؤال غير المباشر نحذف do: what you mean.

questions.question: In an email, when you add a file, you write:
questions.explanation_ar: Please find the attached file = تجد مرفقًا الملف.
questions.explanation_en: This is the email phrase for attachments.

questions.question: "Looking forward to your ___."
questions.explanation_ar: بعد looking forward to اسم أو فعل بـ ing: your reply.
questions.explanation_en: After "looking forward to" use a noun: your reply.

questions.question: You made a mistake. After saying sorry you add:
choices: I'll make sure this doesn't happen again.
questions.explanation_ar: I'll make sure this doesn't happen again = سأحرص على ألا يتكرر.
questions.explanation_en: It promises the mistake won't happen again.

questions.question: Which word is uncountable?
questions.explanation_ar: feedback غير معدودة، لا نقول feedbacks.

questions.question: "I'll send you the report ___ tomorrow." (not later than)
A very important and urgent task is a:

questions.explanation_ar: I'll take care of it = سأتولى الأمر.
questions.explanation_en: It means I will handle it.
